description: Task: write a Python function solve(n, prerequisites) that orders n tasks numbered 0 to n - 1. Each pair [a, b] in the list prerequisites means that task b has to come before task a. Return a list that contains every task exactly once and respects every pair; if several orders are valid, any of them is accepted. If no valid order exists, return an empty list. Here 1 <= n <= 500, 0 <= len(prerequisites) <= 2000, a != b, and no pair is repeated.
